place.name: Folegandros
place.description: Folegandros (also Pholegandros; Greek: Φολέγανδρος, Greek pronunciation: [foˈleɣanðros]) is a small Greek island in the Aegean Sea that — together with Sikinos, Ios, Anafi, and Santorini — forms the southern part of the Cyclades. The island's surface area is 32.216 km2 (12 sq mi; 3,222 ha; 7,961 acres).
